policy.guarantee: Marginal new-rollout false crossing bound under exchangeable independent null rollouts and the identical frozen horizon/eligibility/score pipeline; strict inequality and ties are conservative

gate.note: G2-style conditional diagnostic; Beta-Binomial continuity/exchangeability assumptions are explicit. Combined action FAR is reported separately and is not controlled at release alpha.
